item.title: The 3rd Masters Championship-qual-
item.description:
Contest Information

  • This contest is a team competition and is not subject to AHC ratings or AWTF selection.
  • This contest is for teams (two or three people). No single participant is allowed.

About AtCoder Heuristic Contest（AHC）

This is a series of programming contests that will be held regularly on AtCoder. Unlike algorithm contests such as ABC/ARC/AGC, the goal is to create a better solution to a problem for which it is difficult to find the optimal solution. For examples of problems, see past contests of similar format.

Rules

  • The Masters Championship will provide tools (input generators and local testers) for both the preliminary and final rounds, but will not provide visualizers.
  • There is one problem, but it is divided into several tasks based on different input generation methods, etc. Rankings will be determined by the sum of the highest scores received for each task during the contest. You can use any programming language available on AtCoder.
  • There is no penalty for resubmission, but you must wait at least 5 minutes between submissions. The 5-minute submission interval limits are per team member, per task, and it is possible to submit to multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Teams are required to participate in this contest; single participants are not allowed.
  • Any disclosure of problem discussions or solutions outside of the team prior to the end of the contest is prohibited.
  • Regarding the use of generative AI, the AtCoder Heuristic Contest Generative AI Usage Rules - Version 20250616 apply to both the qual and the final round.
  • For other rules, see here.
